about: Made-up sentences written for OneUptime issue #10373, in the places Data Security reads free text: log lines, exception messages, support and CRM notes, prompts to an assistant, e-mails. Every name and street address here is invented; a street may exist, the number and the person do not. [[N:...]] marks a person's name, [[A:...]] a street address: a house number and a street, with the unit, postcode and city that run on from it. A city or a country alone is not a street address. Titles (Mr., Dr., Frau) stay outside a name. About half the sentences hold neither, on purpose: product, company, service and place names, identifiers, sentence-initial capitals.
